decisions.owner_evidence: Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-CARD-ECHO. Preserve Doppler, valve/chamber/ventricular/congenital assessment and source images/reports. AI image interpretation is separately governed.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-CARD-IMAGING. Retain nuclear cardiology, CT angiography, catheterization references, 3D reconstruction and ventricular-volume detail; a generic model is not patient-derived anatomy.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-CARD-REGISTRY. Own the index and provenance, not duplicate diagnoses or measurements. Preserve ECG, catheterization, surgery, medication history and functional status.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-CARD-SURGERY. Retain corrective/palliative surgery, valve and great-vessel detail, hospital/surgeon identity and imaging follow-up. AI does not authorize surgery.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-CARD-REMOTE. Preserve family consultation, AI translation, ECG/echo review, home wearable/BP/heart-rate/symptom data. A connected device does not prove continuous clinical coverage.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-RENAL-FUNCTION. Retain urea, creatinine, cystatin C, eGFR, urinary markers, protein/albumin, electrolytes, acid-base, recovery and persistent-pattern distinctions. Unknown context cannot imply normality.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-RENAL-TRANSITION. Preserve renal/genetic/pathology/imaging/dialysis/transplant history, emergency context and cross-border language support. Export alone is not completed handover.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-MENTAL-MEDICATION. Preserve start/stop/titration, growth/weight, cardiovascular/metabolic/neurological/sleep effects, adherence, response and adverse reactions. No autonomous prescribing/dose changes.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-MENTAL-THERAPY. Preserve CBT/family/behavioral/supportive therapy, individual/group care, participation/goals and outcomes. Restricted session notes stay separate from shared summaries.

Architectural owner adopted for this bounded documented workflow after existing full-body comparison PED2-ALLERGY-DRUG-LABEL. Retain original label, suspected/confirmed state, drug/class, reaction/timing/severity, alternatives, challenge and specialist decision. Never silently erase history.
